sourceRecords.title: Odfjell Oceanwind Acquires Orsted Majority Stake in Scottish Floating Wind Project
sourceRecords.sourceText: OffshoreWIND.biz reported that Odfjell Oceanwind acquired Orsted 80 per cent share in the 100 MW Salamander floating wind project in Scotland. The source states that Salamander uses Odfjell Oceanwind Deepsea Star semi-submersible steel foundation and had received Scottish consent.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public webpage; source text stored as concise factual evidence for manual archive prototype review.

briefingItems.title: Odfjell takes majority control of Salamander

briefingItems.explanation: The source ties the ownership change to the 100 MW Salamander demonstration project and identifies the selected floating foundation technology.
